import socket

import pytest

import tapedeck.engine.netguard as netguard


@pytest.fixture
def original_socket_constructor(monkeypatch):
    original = socket.socket
    # Register restoration even if a failing implementation leaves socket.socket
    # patched after a test.
    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "socket", original)
    return original


def test_blocks_default_and_explicit_internet_socket_families(
    original_socket_constructor,
):
    with netguard.NoNetwork():
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
            socket.socket()

        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
            socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)

        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
            socket.socket(family=socket.AF_INET, type=socket.SOCK_DGRAM)

        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
            socket.socket(socket.AF_INET6, socket.SOCK_STREAM)

    assert socket.socket is original_socket_constructor


@pytest.mark.skipif(
    not hasattr(socket, "AF_UNIX") or not hasattr(socket, "socketpair"),
    reason="AF_UNIX socketpairs are unavailable on this platform",
)
def test_allows_unix_sockets_and_local_socketpairs(
    original_socket_constructor,
):
    with netguard.NoNetwork():
        with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as unix_socket:
            assert unix_socket.family == socket.AF_UNIX

        left, right = socket.socketpair()
        with left, right:
            left.sendall(b"local-only")
            assert right.recv(len(b"local-only")) == b"local-only"

    assert socket.socket is original_socket_constructor


def test_high_level_connection_helper_is_blocked_without_connecting(
    original_socket_constructor,
):
    with netguard.NoNetwork():
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
            socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", 9), timeout=0.01)

    assert socket.socket is original_socket_constructor


def test_restores_socket_constructor_when_body_raises(
    original_socket_constructor,
):
    class BodyFailure(Exception):
        pass

    with pytest.raises(BodyFailure):
        with netguard.NoNetwork():
            raise BodyFailure("leave the context abruptly")

    assert socket.socket is original_socket_constructor

    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as restored_socket:
        assert restored_socket.family == socket.AF_INET


def test_nested_contexts_keep_outer_guard_active_until_outer_exit(
    original_socket_constructor,
):
    with netguard.NoNetwork():
        outer_guard = socket.socket

        with netguard.NoNetwork():
            inner_guard = socket.socket
            assert inner_guard is not original_socket_constructor

            with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
                socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)

        assert socket.socket is outer_guard
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
            socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)

    assert socket.socket is original_socket_constructor

import socket

import pytest

import tapedeck.engine.netguard as netguard


_REAL_SOCKET = socket.socket
_REAL_CREATE_CONNECTION = socket.create_connection
_REAL_SOCKETPAIR = socket.socketpair


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def restore_socket_apis():
    """Keep deliberately broken guards from contaminating later tests."""
    yield
    socket.socket = _REAL_SOCKET
    socket.create_connection = _REAL_CREATE_CONNECTION
    socket.socketpair = _REAL_SOCKETPAIR


def test_blocks_default_ipv4_and_ipv6_socket_construction_and_restores():
    original_socket = socket.socket

    with netguard.NoNetwork():
        with pytest.raises(
            RuntimeError, match="network access blocked by tapedeck NoNetwork guard"
        ):
            socket.socket()

        with pytest.raises(
            RuntimeError, match="network access blocked by tapedeck NoNetwork guard"
        ):
            socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)

        with pytest.raises(
            RuntimeError, match="network access blocked by tapedeck NoNetwork guard"
        ):
            socket.socket(family=socket.AF_INET, type=socket.SOCK_STREAM)

        ipv6 = getattr(socket, "AF_INET6", None)
        if ipv6 is not None:
            with pytest.raises(
                RuntimeError, match="network access blocked by tapedeck NoNetwork guard"
            ):
                socket.socket(ipv6, socket.SOCK_STREAM)

    assert socket.socket is original_socket

    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as restored_socket:
        assert restored_socket.family == socket.AF_INET


def test_blocks_create_connection_without_attempting_a_real_network_connection():
    original_create_connection = socket.create_connection

    with netguard.NoNetwork():
        with pytest.raises(
            RuntimeError, match="network access blocked by tapedeck NoNetwork guard"
        ):
            socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", 9), timeout=0.01)

    assert socket.create_connection is original_create_connection


def test_allows_unix_domain_sockets_while_network_guard_is_active():
    if not hasattr(socket, "AF_UNIX"):
        pytest.skip("This platform does not provide Unix-domain sockets")

    original_socket = socket.socket

    with netguard.NoNetwork():
        with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as local_socket:
            assert local_socket.family == socket.AF_UNIX

    assert socket.socket is original_socket


def test_allows_unix_socketpairs_needed_by_local_event_loop_mechanisms():
    if not hasattr(socket, "AF_UNIX"):
        pytest.skip("This platform does not provide Unix-domain sockets")

    original_socketpair = socket.socketpair

    with netguard.NoNetwork():
        left, right = socket.socketpair(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        try:
            assert left.family == socket.AF_UNIX
            assert right.family == socket.AF_UNIX
        finally:
            left.close()
            right.close()

    assert socket.socketpair is original_socketpair


def test_guard_remains_active_until_outer_nested_context_exits():
    original_socket = socket.socket

    with netguard.NoNetwork():
        with netguard.NoNetwork():
            with pytest.raises(
                RuntimeError, match="network access blocked by tapedeck NoNetwork guard"
            ):
                socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)

        with pytest.raises(
            RuntimeError, match="network access blocked by tapedeck NoNetwork guard"
        ):
            socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)

    assert socket.socket is original_socket


def test_restores_socket_constructor_when_context_exits_via_exception():
    original_socket = socket.socket

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="sentinel"):
        with netguard.NoNetwork():
            with pytest.raises(
                RuntimeError, match="network access blocked by tapedeck NoNetwork guard"
            ):
                socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
            raise ValueError("sentinel")

    assert socket.socket is original_socket

    with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as restored_socket:
        assert restored_socket.family == socket.AF_INET
